senses.gloss: वश- + अनुग वश- + अनुग, adj. 1. obedient, submissive. 2. subject, Man. 2, 214.
वास- + ओकस् वास- + ओकस्, n. the private apartments; a sleeping-room.
वस्त्र- + कुट्टिम वस्त्र- + कुट्टिम, n. 1. an umbrella. 2. a tent.
वश- + क्रिया वश- + क्रिया, f. 1. subduing by drugs, charms, etc. 2. The drugs, etc., so used.
वस्तु-क्षणात् वस्तु-क्षणात् (abl.), when there is given an opportunity, Rājat. 5, 378.
वस्त्र- + गृह वस्त्र- + गृह, n. a tent.
वास- + गृह वास- + गृह, n. a sleeping room.
वास- + ताम्बूल वास- + ताम्बूल, n. betel mixed with fragrant substances, Daśak. 88, n. 2 Wils.
वाष्प-दुस्-दिन वाष्प-दुस्-दिन, adj. clouded by tears, Daśak. in Chr. 187, 16.
वसु- + देव वसु- + देव, m. the father of Kṛṣṇa.
वासुदेव वासुदेव, i. e. वसु-देव + अ, m. Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu, Johns. Sel. 55, 140; Pañc. 44, 19.
वसु- + देवता वसु- + देवता, f. the lunar asterism, Dhaniṣṭhā.
वस्त्र-पुत्रिका वस्त्र-पुत्रिका, f. a doll.
वसन्त- + बन्धु वसन्त- + बन्धु, m. the god of love, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 11.
वास- + भूमि वास- + भूमि, f. a dwelling-place, Hit. 38, 2, M.M.
वास- + यष्टि वास- + यष्टि, f. a column for a bird to perch on, Megh. 77.
वस्त्र- + युगल वस्त्र- + युगल, n. two garments, Pañc. 29, 16.
वस्त्र- + युग्म वस्त्र- + युग्म, n. two garments.
वास- + योग वास- + योग, m. fragrant powder sprinkled on the cloth.
वसन्त- + योध वसन्त- + योध, m. the god of love, Ṛt. 6, 1.
वसु- + रेतस् वसु- + रेतस्, m. fire, MBh. 1, 1021.
वसु- + रोचिस् वसु- + रोचिस्, n. a religious ceremony in which the Vasus especially are worshipped.
वश- + वर्तिन् वश- + वर्तिन्, adj. acting according [] to another's will, obedient.

वश् वश्, ii. 2 (वश्मि, उश्वस्), Par. To desire, to will, Śāk. d. 179; Chr. 292, 10 = Rigv. i. 86, 10.
 --Cf. ἑκών, ἀέκων, ἕκηλος, εὔκηλος.
† वष् वष्, बष् बष्, i. 1, Par. To hurt or kill.

1. वस् वस्, i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 48, 21).
 1. To dwell, MBh. 1, 749; sometimes with वासम्, Man. 2, 242; Chr. 60, 30; to dwell with (with the loc.), Nal. 15, 7.
 2. To pass (the night), Rām. 1, 29, 1.
 3. To live, Hit. 127, 11 (अस्मद्-सेवया, as our servant). Pass. imps. उष्य, Pañc. 30, 24 (उष्यताम्, may it be lived).
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. उषित.
 1. Dwelt, having dwelt, Chr. 11, 13.
 2. Remaining in or on.
 3. Stale. Anomal. ptcple. of the fut. pass. वास्तव्य, To be dwelt, Pañc. iii. d. 236. m.
 1. An inhabitant, a citizen, Pañc. 48, 25.
 2. A kinsman, a dependent.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. वासय,
 1. To cause to dwell, MBh. 4, 278; to lodge, Hit. 92, 19.
 2. To people, Hit. iii. d. 95.
 3. To receive hospitably, MBh. 3, 982.
 4. To let abide, MBh. 4, 5600. वासित, Well peopled, Hit. iii. d. 95; see s. v.
 --† i. 10, Par. वसय, To dwell.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि,
 1. To inhabit, Rām. 1, 34, 46.
 2. To dwell, Utt. Rāmac. 55, 16.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. समयाध्युषित, see s. v.
 --With अनु अनु,
 1. To dwell with (with acc.), Rām. 2, 37, 26.
 2. To inhabit, Bhaṭṭ. 5, 75. []
 --With अन्तर् अन्तर् (adv.), To dwell in, Śiś. 3, 9.
 --With आ आ
 1. To dwell with (with acc.), Rām. 2, 50, 2.
 2. To inhabit, MBh. 3, 8032.
 3. To have an adulterous connection with (acc.), Man. 8, 374.
 4. To dwell, MBh. 3, 2014.
 5. To undergo, to assume, Man. 3, 2.
 --Caus.
 1. To receive, Rām. 2, 12, 101.
 2. To inhabit, MBh. 3, 12188.
 --With अध्या अधि-आ, To inhabit, MBh. 1, 5512.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To inhabit, Rām. 2, 54, 41.
 --Caus. To pitch, Hit. 84, 11, M.M. (समावासित-कटक, adj. Having pitched his camp).
 --With उद् उद्, Caus. To expel, Pañc. 47, 6.
 --With उप उप,
 1. To inhabit.
 2. To fast, Man. 2, 220. उपोषित,
 1. Fasted.
 2. Who has fasted, Pañc. 199, 12.
 3. Fasting. n. Fast, Man. 5, 155.
 --Caus. To cause to fast, to instruct to fast, Rām. 2, 5, 4.
 --With नि नि,
 1. To dwell, Pañc. 160, 23; Man. 2, 24.
 2. To pass (the night), MBh. 4, 276.
 --With अधिनि अधि-नि, To dwell near (with acc.), Bhartṛ. 3, 77.
 --With संनि सम्-नि, To dwell, MBh. 3, 16777.
 --With निस् निस्, To dwell abroad, MBh. 3, 915(?).
 --Caus.
 1. To expel, MBh. 2, 2644; Pañc. iii. d. 270.
 2. To banish, Utt. Rāmac. 112, 6.
 --With परि परि, पर्युषित,
 1. One who has passed the night, Pañc. 40, 13.
 2. Stale, not fresh, Man. 4, 211; Pañc. ii. d. 102 (of a flower); Häberl. Anthol. 6, 4.
 3. Insipid, Nal. 12, 13; MBh. 3, 2856.
 --With प्र प्र,
 1. To dwell abroad, Rām. 2, 36, 8.
 2. To order to dwell abroad, Rām. 2, 41, 6. प्रोषित,
 1. Departed, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 11.
 2. Absent, being on a journey, Megh. 49.
 --Caus. To send abroad, to banish, Man. 8, 123.
 --With विप्र वि-प्र, [] To dwell abroad, Man. 2, 132. विप्रोषित, Having been abroad, Rām. 2, 103, 26.
 --Caus. To banish, Man. 8, 219.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. To dwell near, Hit. 110, 2.
 2. To dwell, Pañc. 32, 23.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To dwell, to pass, Rām. 1, 23, 23.
 2. To pass away, Pañc. 130, 7.
 --Caus.
 1. To dismiss, MBh. 3, 8277.
 2. To banish, Man. 8, 123.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To dwell, or to live with (with the acc.), Man. 11, 190.
 2. To cohabit (acc.), Man. 9, 77.
 --Cf. Goth. visan; A.S. wesan, ed-wist, werig; O.H.G. wesan and werên, wonên; A.S. wunian; Lat. Vesta, vestibulum, verna; ἄστυ, ἀστός, ἑστία, ὑπερ-ῷον, probably εὐνή, ἰαύω, αὐλή, αὖλις.

2. वस् वस् (the original form of उष्, q. cf.), base of the present, उच्छ, i. 6, Par. To shine, Chr. 287, 3 = Rigv. i. 48, 3 (उच्छात्, conj. imperf. and उवास, pf. red.).
 --Infin. वस्तवे, ib. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2.
 --With the prep. वि वि, व्युष्ट, see separately.
 --Cf. Goth. uhtvo, see उषस्.

3. वस् वस्, ii. 2, Ātm.
 1. To wear, as clothes, Man. 1, 101; 2, 41.
 2. To put on, Man. 4, 116.
 --With नि नि, To put on, Nal. 10, 29.
 --Caus. To put on, MBh. 3, 2631.
 --With प्र प्र, To put on, Rām. 2, 100, 30.
 --With प्रति प्रति, Caus. To dress, MBh. 2, 2502.
 --With वि वि, Caus. To put on, MBh. 2, 2520.
 --Cf. Goth. vasjan (to wear), vasti; A.S. werian; Lat. vestis; ἔννυμι, εἷμα (= ved. वस्मन्, Rigv. iv. 13, 4), ἐσθής.
† 4. वस् वस्, i. 4, Par. To be unbending.

5. वस् वस्, i. 10, वासय, Par. []
 1. † To love.
 2. To cut.
 3. † To take, or to offer, or to kill.
6. ऽवस् 3. -वस्, adj. Wearing, Ragh. 11, 16.

वाश् वाश्, and वास् वास्, i. 4, Ātm. (in epic poetry i. 1, Par. Ātm., MBh. 3, 10493; Nal. 11, 20; 1, 8433; also Mṛcch. 143, 13), To cry, to howl, Ragh. 11, 61.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वाशित, n. The cry of birds or animals. f. ता,
 1. A woman.
 2. A female elephant. Frequent. वावश्य, To cry repeatedly, MBh. 6, 111.
 --With the prep. उद् उद्, To bewail, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 32.

वास् वास्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from वास), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 24), To introduce another quality, to perfume, Gīt. 1, 35.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. वासित.
 1. Made fragrant, Utt. Rāmac. 63, 4.
 2. Filled with fragrance, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 551. see s. v.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि, To adorn, Vikr. d. 127.
 --Cf. वाश्.

वश वश् + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Willing.
 2. Tamed, overpowered, Pañc. 208, 13.
 3. Subdued by charms, fascinated.
 II. m. and n. Wish, desire.
 III. n.
 1. Will, authority, power, Rām. 3, 55, 18; Pañc. 38, 3.
 2. abl. ˚शात्, at the end of a compound word, By means, Pañc. 32, 24; on account of, Vikr. d. 2; Pañc. 33, 6; 148, 10; 264, 23.
 3. Subjection, Pañc. iii. d. 10; 30; वशे कृ, To overpower, Rām. 3, 55, 7; submission, Pañc. iv. d. 60; वशे भू, To be subjected, to obey, Rām. 3, 55, 18.
 4. Birth.
 IV. m.
 1. The residence of harlots.
 2. A proper name, Chr. 296, 10 = Rigv. i. 112, 10.
 V. f. शा.
 1. A wife.
 2. A daughter.
 3. A husband's sister.
 4. A woman.
 5. A cow.
 6. A female elephant, Vikr. d. 110.
 7. A barren cow.
 8. A barren woman, Man. 8, 28.
 --Comp.

वसा वसा, f.
 1. Marrow, Nalod. 3, 11; brain (-चटा, the mass of the brain), Kathās. 25, 274.
 2. Fat, adeps, Pañc. 253, 23.
 3. Oily exudation, Man. 5, 135.

वास वास, i. e. 1. 3. वस् and वास्, + अ,
 I. m.
 1. Dwelling, Man. 2, 67; resting, Megh. 77; living, Pañc. i. d. 347; Hit. i. d. 113, M.M.; with वस्, to dwell, to live (see s. v. 1. वस्).
 2. A dwellingplace, Vikr. d. 43; a habitation, a house, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 12; Lass. 75, 10.
 3. Cloth, Kathās. 3, 71.
 4. Perfuming, Vikr. d. 38; perfume, Śiś. 9, 52.
 II. m., and f. सा, A plant, Justicia ganderusa.
 --Comp.
वशंवदत्व वशं-वद-त्व, i. e. वश + म्-वद् + अ + त्व, n. Speaking compliantly, Ragh. 18, 12.

वशग वश + ग,
 1. adj. Obedient, subject, MBh. 3, 14687; Pañc. i. d. 155; 285.
 2. f. गा, An obedient wife.
वशतस् वश + तस्, adv. In consequence, or on account, of the power of, Bhartṛ. 2, 91.
वशता वश + ता, f. Subjection, Cāṇ. 65 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 411.
वशि वश् + इ, n. Subduing by magical means, bewitching.
वसि 3. वस् + इ, (m. f. ?), Clothes.
वाशि वाशि, m. Fire.
वाशी वाश् + ई, f. Roar, prayer(?), Chr. 293, 3 = Rigv. i. 88, 3.
वासि वासि, f. A carpenter's adze or chisel.
वशिक वशिक, adj. Empty.

वशिता वशि + ता, f. वशित्व वशि + त्व, n., or वशिन् + ता, or त्व,
 1. Subduing by magical means, Lass. 3, 19 (त्व).
 2. Subjugation, dominion, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2977.

वासित वासित,
 I. see वस्, वास्.
 II. n.
 1. Sound.
 2. The cry of birds.
 3. Knowledge.
 III. f. ता.
 1. A woman. []
 2. A female elephant, Johns. Sel. 12, 32; Ragh. 19, 11.

वशिन् वशिन्, i. e. वश + इन्,
 I. adj., f. नी, Subdued.
 II. m. One who has subdued his senses, a sage, Śāk. d. 47.
 III. f. नी.
 1. A tree, Mimosa Sama Roxb.
 2. A parasite plant.

वासिन् वासिन्, adj., f. नी, i. e.
 I. 1. वस् + इन्, Inhabiting, Pañc. 129, 14.
 II. वास + इन्, Clothed, Johns. Sel. 59, 184; wearing clothes, Rām. 3, 52, 19; 25.
 --Comp.

वशिर वशिर,
 I. m. The name of several plants.
 II. n. Sea salt (cf. वसुक).
वशिष्ठ वशिष्ठ (in the Vedas वसिष्ठ वसिष्ठ, properly superl. of वसु), m. The name of a Ṛṣi, Man. 1, 35; Chr. 296, 9 = Rigv. i. 112, 9 (स्).
वसिष्ठ वसिष्ठ, m. The name of a Ṛṣi; cf. वशिष्ठ.

वासिष्ठ वासिष्ठ, i. e. वसिष्ठ + अ, adj.
 1. Composed by Vasiṣṭha, Man. 11, 249.
 2. Explained by Vasiṣṭha.

वशीकरण वशीकरण, i. e. वश-कृ + अन,
 1. Subduing in general, Pañc. i. d. 80.
 2. Subduing by magical expedients.

वश्य वश्य, i. e. वश + य,
 I. adj., f. या.
 1. Governable, able to be subdued, Pañc. iii. d. 128; subdued, Pañc. 156, 10; 23, 3; being in one's power, 146, 24.
 2. Obedient, ib. 46, 20.
 II. m. A dependent, a slave.
 III. f. या, An obedient wife.
 IV. n. Cloves.
 --Comp.
ऽवश्यकता -वश्यकता, in अ-, i. e. अ-वश्य + क + ता, f. Necessity, Hit. 116, 10.
वषट् वषट् (probably for वक्षत्, ved. conj. aor. of वह्), ind. An exclamation used on making an oblation to a deity with fire; cf. कृ.
वषट्कार वषट्-कार, m. Oblation with fire, Hariv. 11187.
वषट्कृति वषट्-कृति, f. Oblation with fire, Lass. 100, 11 = Rigv. vii. 11, 6.
† वष्क् वष्क्, विष्क् विष्क्, i. 10, Par. To see; see वस्क्.
† वस्क् वस्क्, वष्क् वष्क्, वक्क् वक्क्, i. 1, Ātm. To go.

वष्क वष्क, वष्कय वष्कय, and वस्कय वस्कय, i. e. 1. वस् + क, and वस् + क + य, m. A one-year-old calf.
 --Cf. Lat. vacca.
वस्क वस्क, m. Perseverance.
वष्कयणी वष्कयणी, वस्कयणी वस्कयणी, and वष्कयिणी वष्कयिणी (i. e. वष्कय + इन् + ई; cf. the last), f. A cow bearing many calves.

वसति and ती वसती̆ (vb. 1. वस्), f.
 1. A dwelling-place, Vikr. d. 137 (ति); Pañc. 123, 16 (ति, at the end of a comp. adj.).
 2. A house, Nalod. 4, 29.
 3. (perhaps vb. 3. वस्), Night, Sāv. 4, 5; figurat., Chr. 48, 4 (ति).
 --Comp.

वसन 1. 3. वस् + अन, n.
 1. A dwelling.
 2. Covering.
 3. Cloth, Vikr. d. 115.
 4. Also f. ना, An ornament worn by women round the loins.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἑανός.

वासन वासन, i. e. 1. 3. वस् and वास्, + अन,
 I. n.
 1. Abiding, abode.
 2. Any receptacle.
 3. A box, a basket.
 4. A water-jar.
 5. A particular posture.
 6. Knowledge.
 7. Steeping, infusing.
 8. Cloth.
 9. An envelope.
 10. Perfuming.
 II. f. ना.
 1. An impression remaining unconsciously in the mind from past actions, etc., and, by the resulting merit or demerit, producing pleasure or pain, Bhāṣāp. 162. Cf. Ballantyne, Yoga. ii. 12.
 2. Trust, confidence.
 3. Imagination, fancy, Vedāntas. in Chr. 218, 1; 219, 2.
 --Comp.

वसन्त वसन्त, m.
 1. The season of spring, Pañc. v. d. 4; personified, Lass. 2. ed. 51, 26.
 2. Diarrhœa.
 3. Small-pox.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἔαρ; Lat. ver.

वासन्त वासन्त, i. e. वसन्त + अ,
 I. adj.
 1. Vernal, growing in the spring, Man. 6, 11.
 2. Young, in the spring of life.
 3. Diligent in the performance of religious ceremonies.
 II. m.
 1. The Indian cuckoo.
 2. The southern wind.
 3. Any young animal.
 4. A camel.
 5. A catamite.
 6. The name of several [] plants.
 III. f. ती.
 1. The name of a deity, Utt. Rāmac. 37, 14; 46, 11.
 2. A festival in honour of Kāma.
 3. The name of several plants.

वसु वसु,
 I. adj.
 1. Sweet.
 2. Dry.
 II. m.
 1. A kind of demigod, Rām. 3, 52, 42; MBh. 1, 2582.
 2. A name of Agni.
 3. Śiva.
 4. Kuvera, Kir. 1, 18.
 5. The sun.
 6. A ray of light, Śiś. 9, 10 (at the end of a comp. adj.; cf. 2. वस्).
 7. A rein.
 8. The tie of a yoke.
 9. A [] tree.
 10. The name of two plants.
 11. A kind of fish.
 12. A proper name, Lass. 2. ed. 67, 21.
 III. n.
 1. Wealth, Lass. 100, 8 = Rigv. vii. 15, 4 (वस्वस्, ved. abl.); Nal. 5, 48; Daśak. in Chr. 184, 14.
 2. Gold, MBh. 3, 13472.
 3. A gem.
 4. Water.
 5. A sort of salt.
 6. A yellow kind of kidney bean.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. ἐΰς, ἐάων, cf. वस्न.
वासु वासु, m. Viṣṇu; वासू, see s. v.
वासू वासू, i. e. वास् + उ, f. A young girl, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 24; 187, 14.

वसुक वसु + क,
 I. m.
 1. A tree, Sesbana grandiflora.
 2. A shrub, Asclepias gigantea.
 II. n. Sea salt (cf. वशिर).
वसुदेवभू वसु-देव-भू, m. Kṛṣṇa.

वसुधा वसु-धा, f. The earth, Vikr. d. 16.
 --Comp.
वसुधाधर वसुधा-धर, i. e. वसुधा-धृ + अ, m. A mountain, Vikr. d. 16.
वसुधार वसुधार, i. e. वसु-धृ + अ, adj. Having wealth, Hit. ii. d. 102 (cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2220).
वसुंधरा वसुंधरा, i. e. वसु + म्-धृ + अ, f. The earth, Pañc. 101, 23.

वसुमन्त् वसु + मन्त्,
 I. adj., f. मती, Wealthy, Johns. Sel. 6, 33.
 II. f. मती.
 1. The earth, Vikr. d. 79.
 2. A proper name.
वसूयु वसूयु, i. e. वसूय, a ved. denomin. derived from वसु, + उ, adj. Desiring wealth, Chr. 289, 4 = Rigv. i. 49, 4.
वस्कय वस्कय, and वस्कयणी वस्कयणी, see वष्क.
† वस्त् वस्त्, i. 1, Ātm. To torment.

वस्त वस्त,
 I. m. A goat, Man. 11, 138.
 II. i. e. 1. वस् + त, n. A house.
वास्त वास्त, i. e. वस्त + अ, adj. Made, derived, or coming, from goats, Man. 2, 41.

वस्ति वस्ति, m. and f.
 1. The belly below the navel, Man. 8, 234.
 2. The bladder, Suśr. 2, 201, 12.
 3. A bag made of bladder.
 4. Abiding (vb. 1. वस्).
 5. pl. The skirt of a cloth (vb. 3. वस्).
 --Comp.

वस्तु 1. वस् + तु, n.
 1. Natural disposition.
 2. Essence, the true object, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 10; substance, wealth, Lass. 12, 14.
 3. Object, Bhartṛ. 2, 37; thing, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 9, Pañc. 253, 19; means, Hit. i. d. 30, M.M.
 4. The object of love, Megh. 111.
 5. The subject of a poem or play, Vikr. 3, 8.
 --Comp.

वास्तु वास्तु (vb. 1. वस्), m. and n.
 1. The site of a building, a building-place.
 2. Ground, Man. 3, 255.
 3. A house.
 --Comp.
वस्तुतस् वस्तु + तस्, adv. Essentially, in fact, Siddh. Mukt. 76, 4.
वस्तुता वस्तु + ता, in परिहास-, f. Condition of being the object of derision, Pañc. iii. d. 261.
वस्त्य 1. वस् + त्य, or वस्त + य, n. A house.

वस्त्र 3. वस् + त्र, n. m. Cloth, garment, Pañc. 29, 10; bed-linen, 62, 13.
 --Comp.
वास्त्र वास्त्र, i. e. वस्त्र + अ, adj. Covered with cloth.

वस्न वस्न,
 I. m.
 1. Price.
 2. Wages.
 II. n.
 1. Wealth.
 2. Abiding [] (vb. 1. वस्).
 3. Substance, thing.
 4. Cloth (vb. 3. वस्).
 5. Skin.
 --Cf. ὦνος (for ϝόςνος); Lat. venum (acc.), ven-dere. The vb. which is the base of वस्न is probably also the base of वसु (q. cf.), ἐΰ, and ἐσθλός, ἐσλός.
वस्नसा वस्नसा, i. e. अव-स्नसा, f. A tendon, a nerve.
वस्निक वस्निक, i. e. वस्न + इक, adj., f. की, Living on, or getting, wages.

वस्वौकसारा वस्वौकसारा, i. e. probably वसु-ओक-सार, f.
 1. The capital of Kuvera, Ragh. 16, 10.
 2. That of Indra.
 3. The name of a lake.
वाशीमन्त् वाशी + मन्त्, adj. Roaring, Chr. 293, 6 = Rigv. i. 87, 6.
वाशुरा वाशुरा, f. Night.

वासुरा वासुरा, f.
 I. probably वास् + उ + र.
 1. A woman (cf. the next).
 2. A female elephant.
 II. (vb. 1. वस्).
 1. Night.
 2. The earth.

वाश्र वाश्र,
 I. m. A day (cf. वासर).
 II. n.
 1. A dwelling.
 2. A place where four roads meet.
 3. Dung.

वाष्प वाष्प (and वास्प वास्प),
 I. m. n.
 1. Vapour, Ragh. 13, 29; steam [] (cf. Pañc. 262, 21).
 2. A tear, Pañc. 160, 5.
 3. n. Iron.
 II. f. पी, A drug, commonly हिङ्गुपत्री.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Lat. vappa, perhaps vāpor (cf. 1. वा).
वास्प वास्प, see वाष्प.
वाष्पाय वाष्पाय, a denomin. derived from वाष्प with य, Ātm. To shed tears, Vikr. d. 147; Mālat. 102, 11.
वासनामयत्व वासना + मय + त्व, n. State of (or consisting in) imagination, Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 6.
वासन्तक वासन्त + क, adj. Vernal.

वासन्तिक वासन्तिक, i. e. वसन्त + इक,
 I. adj. Vernal, Śāk. 78, 18.
 II. m. The buffoon in a drama.

वासर वासर (vb. 2. वस्),
 I. m. and n. A day, Pañc. ii. d. 99; Kathās. 4, 23 (m.); Megh. 104 (n.).
 II. m. A kind of snake.

वासव वासव, i. e. वसु + अ,
 I. m. Indra, Chr. 22, 23.
 II. f. वी, The mother of Vyāsa.
 III. adj., f. वी, Belonging to Indra, Megh. 44.

वासस् वासस्, i. e. 3. वस् + अस्, n.
 1. Cloth, clothes, Hit. ii. d. 38.
 2. Curtain, Rām. 1, 13, 29 (read वासोभिः).
 --Comp.
वासुकि वासुकि, m. The serpent Vāsuki, sovereign of the snakes, Bhag. 10, 28.

वास्तव वास्तव, and वास्तविक i. e. वस्तु + अ, or इक, adj.
 1. Being anything in the true sense of the word; real, substantial.
 2. Demonstrated.
वास्तव्य वास्तव्य, see 1. वस्.
वास्तिक वास्तिक, i. e. वस्त + इक, n. Goats, Rām. 2, 62, 2, ed. Seramp.
वास्तुक and वास्तूक वास्तू̆क, n. A potherb, Lass. 79, 14 (ऊ).
वास्तोस्पति वास्तोस्पति (वास्तोस्, gen. of वास्तु), m. The deity of the house (Man. 3, 89), a name of Indra.
वास- + वेश्मन् वास- + वेश्मन्, n. the inner part of a house, a sleeping-room, Kathās. 22, 104.
